name: aero-bubble-meadow
prompt: Vertical frame shot from ground level, the lens nestled low among blades of grass and tilted steeply upward. Tall slender blades of vivid lime-green grass rise into the frame from the bottom and both edges, each blade unnaturally smooth and glossy as if lacquered, with sunlit yellow-lime tips, deep emerald shadows at their bases and tiny round dew droplets clinging along their edges, each droplet holding its own pinpoint of light. Above them a flawless saturated cyan sky deepens to rich royal blue at the very top, crossed by a few thin, feathery white cloud wisps. Large transparent soap bubbles float upward through the frame at different heights and sizes, their thin skins swirling with faint rainbow film of magenta, gold and teal, each topped by a crisp white crescent highlight from the high overhead sun and a softer glint on its lower rim. One big bubble in the lower middle of the frame is razor sharp and works like a curved mirror, holding a tiny warped reflection of the bright meadow and sky; the bubbles farther away melt into soft round circles of blurred light. In the upper left corner a gentle white and pale-cyan sun flare blooms with a few faint circular rings trailing diagonally across the sky. Macro lens, very shallow depth of field, crisp high-key midday light, super saturated clean palette of lime, cyan, aqua and pure white, polished and immaculate like a glossy mid-2000s computer desktop background or an upbeat stock photograph about a bright tomorrow, cheerful to the point of feeling slightly too perfect. No people, no text, no lettering, no logos. Thanks.

name: aero-eco-city-figure
prompt: Seen from high above at golden hour, a glossy utopian eco city in the optimistic green-tech style of a 2008 sustainability brochure fills the tall frame: clusters of pearl-white towers with soft rounded curves step upward like stacked petals, each balcony and roof overflowing with ferns, shrubs and young trees; on the rolling lime-green hills beyond, a line of slender white wind turbines spins, their blades smeared with motion; transparent geodesic greenhouse domes shelter palms and catch the light; a sleek white maglev train slides along a looping raised track; a turquoise lagoon, perfectly calm, reflects the whole skyline like a mirror. The surfaces gleam as if freshly polished, colours are juicy and saturated, curved edges carry bright white glints, and a soft cyan sun flare and a few drifting translucent light spheres hang in the upper air. The city is entirely deserted: vacant plazas, an empty train, untouched paths, not a single soul. Near the bottom of the frame, small against all this, a smooth white walkway curves past a glossy railing, and on it one figure stands utterly motionless, facing us head-on with arms hanging loose, wearing a dark charcoal knitted balaclava that encloses the whole head with no holes for eyes, nose or mouth, a large white stitched ring circling the entire face, and high inside that ring on the right side of the picture one small red triangle with rounded corners pointing down; dark gloves, plain dark clothing, not a patch of skin showing. A single rainbow-sheened soap bubble floats still beside its shoulder. At the farthest rim of the sky, low behind the hills, a faint dull-grey haze has begun to seep into the blue. Tall portrait framing, deep focus throughout, warm honey sunlight raking in from the left, a palette of sky blue, lime, white, turquoise and gold broken only by that cold grey smear. Every sign panel, every hull and wall is plain and unmarked, carrying no writing or emblems of any kind. Thanks.

name: aqua-orb-underwater
prompt: Tall portrait shot from deep inside a sunny lagoon, the camera low and angled up toward the light through water so clean and turquoise it looks freshly rendered. High overhead the surface is a shimmering silver-white ceiling, and broad shafts of sunshine slant down through it in long diagonal bands that soften and fade before they reach the pale sand. Suspended dead centre, a flawless clear glass sphere about the size of a beach ball hangs weightless: a crisp crescent of white light gleams along its top rim, a gentle cyan glow wraps its underside, and the bright water behind it bends and magnifies as if seen through a lens. Where the beams pass through the sphere they break into a trembling web of light ripples across the sand beneath. Three plump orange goldfish with trailing veil tails glide past on the left, a pair of yellow-and-black banded reef fish dart across to the right, and from a pale coral at the bottom of the frame a thin chain of silver bubbles wobbles upward past the glass toward the sun. The whole scene is glossy, spotless and slightly too perfect, like a desktop aquarium on an early-2000s computer left running in a bright office: saturated aqua, cyan and pure white with warm orange accents, crisp high-definition detail, soft bloom on every highlight, no murk, no debris, no people, no text or lettering anywhere. Thanks.

name: photo-dump-2016-flatlay
prompt: Looking straight down from directly above onto an unmade bed with a crumpled white duvet, an outfit laid out flat as if someone is planning their Saturday: a red and black checked flannel shirt spread open with its sleeves flung wide, a pair of pale blue skinny jeans torn open at both knees, a thin black velvet choker coiled in a loose loop at the collar, gold-framed aviator sunglasses with mirrored lenses, a pair of scuffed white canvas lace-up trainers placed toe to toe, and a crown of small pink and cream silk flowers resting where a head would be. Beside the clothes, balanced on the duvet, sits a round coconut-shell bowl of deep purple acai with neat rows of banana coins, blueberries, raspberries and a scatter of golden granola, a spoon resting across the rim. Soft early-morning sun pours in from a window on the left, throwing long warm shadows across the fabric creases. The frame is tilted a few degrees off level and slightly crooked, casually snapped on a phone held at arm's length for a camera-roll dump. The colour treatment is a heavy mid-2010s app filter: blacks lifted to a milky charcoal, highlights pushed honey-gold, colours turned up loud so the flannel red and the acai purple almost glow, a faint warm vignette and fine digital grain. No people, no faces, no hands, no writing, labels or logos on anything. Thanks.

name: festival-sunset-figure
prompt: Tall portrait snapshot taken in a festival meadow during the summer of 2016, the sun a hand's width above a treeline and sinking fast. Trampled grass, hay-coloured dust lifting in the backlight, sagging lines of warm bulb lights strung on timber posts above, half of them just flickering on. Tissue confetti in coral, gold and aqua tumbles through the air, frozen mid-drop. All around, a jubilant crowd turned away from us and melted into soft blur: bare shoulders, arms flung up, crochet tops, cut-off denim, braided hair woven with crowns of artificial daisies and peonies, nobody looking back. Exactly in the middle distance, the single crisp thing in the whole picture, a lone figure stands square to the lens, utterly motionless, arms hanging, a gloved fist gripping a burning sparkler that spits a tiny white fizz. Its head is covered by a dark knitted balaclava with no openings for eyes, nose or mouth, so not a speck of skin is visible; a bold white ring is stitched all the way round the face, and inside that ring, up high and toward the viewer's right, sits one little red downward-pointing triangle whose corners are rounded off. Black gloves, plain dark layers, nothing mechanical. Captured at shoulder height on a cheap mid-2010s phone lens, a touch wide, the low sun parked just past the right edge so a huge amber-and-rose flare with polygon ghosts smears across the dancers. Graded like a heavily filtered upload of that year: milky raised shadows, cranked saturation, tangerine highlights, a pink wash, fine grain, a gentle dark vignette. Happy chaos melting everywhere, one rigid sharp silhouette at its centre. Keep the frame free of words, signs, banners and printed marks. Thanks.

name: chill-guy-flat-backdrop
prompt: Full-length portrait, camera level with the chest, of one lone figure planted dead centre on a single seamless sweep of pale peach-apricot paper that runs unbroken from floor to top edge, flat as an empty meme template. The figure's head is wrapped in a snug charcoal knitted balaclava that is completely closed, unbroken wool over the brow, the nose bridge and the lips; a broad loop of white stitching rings the entire face; inside that loop, up toward the top on the viewer's right, a little red triangle, corners rounded off, its apex aiming downward. Grey knit gloves, so not a patch of skin is visible. It wears a baggy oversized oatmeal cardigan that drowns the wrists, hanging open over a plain cream tee, loose khaki cargo trousers rumpling over chunky off-white trainers. Body language of total unbothered calm: both gloved fists buried deep in the cardigan pockets, hips cocked so the weight rests on one leg, the other knee soft, shoulders slack and rounded, the masked head leaning a few degrees as though faintly amused by the whole world. Straight-on 50mm look, head to soles in frame, the figure sitting low and compact with generous empty peach space overhead and either side for captions to go on later. Big soft frontal studio light, almost shadowless, just a faint grey shadow pooling under the trainers, matte knit texture readable. Palette of peach, oatmeal, khaki, charcoal and white, with that one red mark as the only accent. The paper sweep stays blank and unmarked, nothing written or printed on it or on the clothes. Thanks.

name: lofi-night-window-figure
prompt: Tall portrait frame of a snug little bedroom in the small hours, viewed from a few steps back across the room at sitting height, slightly off to one corner. In the window bay, a figure lounges sideways along a wide padded sill, back propped on one wall of the recess, both knees bent up, feet in fluffy socks, the whole body loose and sunk into the cushions like it has nowhere to be. Its head is wrapped completely in a dark navy knitted balaclava, solid wool where eyes, nose and mouth would be, not a sliver of skin showing. A broad loop of bright white yarn is sewn around the full oval of the face, and up near the top of that loop, on the right as we look at it, sits a little red triangle with soft rounded points, its tip aimed downward. Huge padded headphones clamp over the wool. It wears a baggy mustard hoodie with the sleeves pushed down over dark knitted gloves, and both gloved hands cup a fat speckled mug from which a lazy ribbon of steam rises. Its head is tilted back against the glass in pure contentment, angled three-quarters to us. Behind it the window is beaded and streaked with rain, and through the wet pane a far-off skyline of stacked flats and towers glimmers in bubblegum pink, lilac and electric blue, softened into dreamy smears of colour. On the near side of the room: a small wooden desk with a bendy lamp pouring syrupy orange light onto an open notebook and a crooked pile of library books, a leafy monstera in a terracotta pot, a strand of tiny warm bulbs draped along a shelf, a rumpled duvet just catching the edge of frame. Soft hand-drawn animation look, cel-style flat shading with gentle gradients, faint paper grain, glowing halos around each bulb, warm amber indoors meeting cool violet night at the window frame, low contrast and hushed, the cosy calm before a word is said. Nothing written anywhere in the picture: no words, signage, labels or brand marks, and no pets. Thanks.

name: millennial-optimism-loft
prompt: A tall portrait photograph of an empty converted warehouse flat on a golden late afternoon, nobody in it, the camera tucked down in one corner of the room at roughly waist height with a slightly wide lens so the old brick walls lean in a little and the ceiling beams run away overhead. Big multi-pane steel-framed industrial windows fill the back wall and pour thick honey-coloured sun across scuffed wide floorboards, with specks of dust drifting through the light. Bare amber filament bulbs dangle on long black cords from the rafters and a loose string of warm fairy lights is looped along the exposed brick. Nearest the lens, a low coffee table made of rough salvaged planks holds a glass preserving jar stuffed with daisies and cornflowers, a second jar glowing with tea lights, a cream mug covered in a tiny repeating curled-moustache pattern, and a stack of record sleeves in plain brown kraft card. Behind it a cracked tan leather sofa with a chunky knitted throw and a small ukulele resting against one arm. A turntable sits on an upturned crate in the midground with its lid up. By the door, a skinny single-speed bicycle with a mint-green frame leans against the brick. One wall is painted matte blackboard black and wiped completely clean, and every other surface stays bare and unprinted, so the edit can lay its own bright captions over it later. The whole frame is graded like a phone snapshot from 2012 run through a faded vintage filter: lifted milky blacks, creamy yellow-beige highlights, slightly washed mint and peach midtones, edges going gently soft and a soft dark vignette in the corners. Hopeful, cosy and a touch smug, the feeling of a cheap first flat when everything was going to work out. Thanks.

name: proper-country-mall
prompt: A tall portrait snapshot taken by someone leaning over the brass-and-glass balustrade of the third floor of a huge suburban shopping centre, looking straight down into its central atrium on a busy Saturday afternoon in about 2005. The near edge of the frame is the top rail of that balustrade, caught bright and slightly blown out by the camera's own little flash, a fingerprint smear of glare on the glass panel below it. Beneath, three stacked galleries of shopfronts curve around the void, each one a plain lit window of folded clothes, trainers or homeware under a smooth fascia band painted a single flat colour and left completely blank. At the bottom sits a three-tier marble fountain throwing white plumes into a round pool whose floor glitters with hundreds of copper and silver coins, ringed by big potted palms and slatted wooden benches. A capsule lift with glass walls hangs halfway up its column, a few tiny passengers inside. Further down, a crowded food court of round tables and plastic trays, shoppers as small soft blurs mid-stride with carrier bags swinging, every face too small and smeared to read. Overhead a long barrel-vault skylight pours flat white daylight over everything, bouncing off glossy cream floor tiles and polished chrome. Shot on a cheap early digital compact: slightly soft, a touch of sensor noise in the shadows, highlights that wash out to white, colours a little faded toward warm cream, mint, terracotta and pale blue, horizon a few degrees off level. Every surface is wordless: bare shop fascias, plain carrier bags, unmarked trays and cups. Busy, warm, prosperous, ordinary: the feeling that there was money and somewhere to go. Thanks.

name: aero-closing-horizon
prompt: Tall portrait frame, the final resting screen of an optimistic mid-2000s desktop paradise as dusk arrives. Across only the lowest fifth rises a single smooth grassy mound, rounded like a pillow, its lawn so even it looks polished, glowing electric lime on the sunlit crown and sliding into deep emerald along the side that turns away from the light. Above it opens a colossal unbroken sky, glossy as lacquered glass: rich cyan overhead, softening through bright seawater aqua, then settling into a hushed dusky blue that meets the grass, with one faint pastel shimmer of aurora low along the skyline. Everything above the mound for the top two thirds is empty, smooth gradient sky, a clean resting place left for something to appear later. Five or six clear soap bubbles drift upward and off to the left from behind the crest, each with a bright pane of reflected light and an oily rainbow rim, the highest ones dwindling to pinpricks. Planted dead centre on the crest, tiny in the frame and visible from boots to crown, a solitary person faces straight into the camera with arms resting at the sides: dark zip jacket, dark trousers, knitted dark gloves, and a close-fitting charcoal wool balaclava covering the whole head with no openings for eyes, nose or mouth, so no skin is visible anywhere. A thick white stitched ring outlines the entire face, and high inside that ring, on the right-hand side of the picture, one small red downward-pointing triangle with softly rounded corners. Long-lens view from far off and slightly below, level horizon, the person crisp, a narrow rim of golden evening light along the shoulders, sleek computer-rendered finish with gentle glow and bloom, candy-bright colours muted to a calm hush. Mood: serene, courteous, a held breath at the end of a promise, the quiet after someone says watch this space. No lettering, signs, logos or symbols anywhere in the image. Thanks.
